newsitem.title: CHINA: China's Tianjin launches $566 mln port expansion.
newsitem.headline: China's Tianjin launches $566 mln port expansion.

text.p: China's northern city of Tianjin has launched a 4.7 billion yuan ($566 million) expansion of its port to boost handling capacity, the Xinhua news agency said.
The expansion would add five multi-function berths, five bulk carrier and specialised liquefied chemical berths and two international passenger berths, Xinhua said in a Saturday report.
Listed as a key state project in the Ninth Five-Year Plan (1996-2000), the expansion would include dredging the port's main navigation channel.

The first phase of the project would include transforming and expanding three berths of a barge terminal and a salt terminal, raising their handling capacity to 1.2 million tonnes, it said. It did not give their current capacity.
The terminals would be able to handle bulk and sundry goods carriers upon completion of the first phase, it said, but gave no further details. ($1 = 8.3 yuan)
